name: canvasai
description: AI-assisted diagram editor built on the Excalidraw component.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node scripts/vercel-output.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
